subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should this remain a separate persistent forum-topic investigation after the guarded-lane recovery work, or is a merged lane-release fix enough to close it?
rationale: The code proves an overlapping in-process lane guard, but the issue's unique user evidence is a per-topic black hole that survives process restart and manual session repair, which needs maintainer judgment and live/state proof.

options.title: Keep Separate Until Proven
options.body: Keep this issue open until live or restart-replay proof shows the persistent per-topic black hole is fixed.

options.title: Fold Into Lane Recovery
options.body: Fold it into the guarded-lane tracker only if maintainers confirm the same root cause covers the post-restart forum-topic behavior.

options.title: Split After Landing
options.body: Land an in-process recovery fix and open a narrower persistent-state follow-up if the forum-topic case still reproduces.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Until Proven
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until live or restart-replay proof shows the persistent per-topic black hole is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Telegram isolated-spool and buffered-replay work is the strongest current-main owner trail for the affected recovery paths.
